direction: Full-area botanical compositions with a centered, opaque cream clay slab-serif heading overlaid in the foreground.

assets.title: Темперамент
assets.prompt:
Use case: compositing / style-transfer.
Asset type: finished Russian mini-app TEST CATEGORY banner.
Input image 1 is this category's existing banner: botanical identity and exact title reference. Input image 2 is the USER-APPROVED NEW COMPOSITION, layering, typography, material and density reference. Redesign image 1 following the visual system of image 2.

The botanical artwork must cover the ENTIRE banner area edge-to-edge, with large forms cropped naturally at all four edges. No large empty burgundy patch, no blank left half or reserved text column. Small deep burgundy gaps can remain between leaves. The full composition flows behind the heading. Keep the category identity in the scene below; don't copy the human face, portrait title, or mixed plant species from image 2.

Place the requested title on ONE centered horizontal line in the FRONTMOST layer across the middle, horizontally centered, overlaying the botanical illustration on both left and right. Letters are entirely opaque and never hidden by foliage. Do not weave leaf stems through letters. Match the approved warm ivory rounded heavy SLAB-SERIF clay lettering, conventional upright Cyrillic, soft volume, delicate clay grain and restrained dark burgundy drop shadow for contrast over the leaves. Same font size for every category: normalized at 960x400, capitals 74px high and lowercase x-height 52px. Never enlarge short titles (especially Личность), and do not shrink long ones; a long word may span about 85% of the banner width, leaving clear side margins. Same stroke thickness, letter proportions and material as reference image 2. No title panel, plaque, ribbon, all caps, subtitle, UI icon, border, watermark or extra words.

Wide landscape 2.4:1 canvas, one banner only. Restrained botanical plasticine, few LARGE meaningful forms, moderate detail, warm soft lighting. Limited sage/ochre/terracotta palette plus each species' natural fruit color. No ground strip, soil, platform, pedestal or miniature landscape.
Scene and meaning: OAK / TEMPERAMENT: Six to eight very large deeply LOBED OAK LEAVES fan across the entire canvas in different directions, with flowing diagonal oak twigs connecting their gestures. Sage, muted ochre and terracotta leaves express different rhythms of responding, with one or two unmistakable acorns anchoring the composition. One leaf rises, another bends sideways, another sweeps down: lively but controlled wind-like movement. The oak must be botanically recognizable. Fill the left side and all corners as fully as the right, with big edge-cropped leaves.
Only exact text (verbatim): "Темперамент". Correct Cyrillic spelling.

assets.title: Мой портрет личности
assets.prompt:
Use case: compositing.
Edit the supplied clay portrait banner. The user requests that the botanical composition USE THE ENTIRE BANNER AREA. Currently the whole left half and lower-left area are empty burgundy; fix this decisively.

Create a full-bleed, edge-to-edge botanical clay composition across the ENTIRE 2.4:1 canvas, behind the existing title. Retain the recognizable human face in profile assembled from large sage, ochre, terracotta and ivory clay leaves on the right. Extend those same large flowing leaf shapes and curved leaf stems continuously into the LEFT HALF, upper-left and lower-left corners, and along the top and bottom edges. Use only about 6–8 large additional overlapping leaves, some cropped naturally by the canvas edges. Their layered curves should visually flow into the portrait, expressing different traits assembling into one personality. Build one coherent broad composition spanning left edge to right edge, not a small portrait plus decorative corner sprinkles. Burgundy may show in small gaps between the leaves, but there must be NO large empty burgundy region on either side, at the top or at the bottom. No dense tiny detailing, no flowers, fruit, frames, medallions or new objects.

Retain the exact two-line foreground title:
"Мой портрет
личности"
Preserve its approved warm ivory rounded slab-serif clay typeface, approximate font size and centered alignment. All letters stay fully opaque, clearly on TOP of the botanical illustration, overlapping leaves on BOTH the left and right. Do not weave stems through the lettering or hide any letter behind a leaf. Use a restrained dark burgundy soft drop shadow immediately behind the letters for contrast over the foliage. No text panel, ribbon, plaque, gradient block, additional text or watermark.

Same restrained plasticine material and soft warm lighting as the reference. Large simple leaf forms, moderate detail, limited sage/ochre/terracotta/ivory palette. Wide landscape 2.4:1, output the complete banner alone.
